evidence_candidates.excerpt: Samsung announced commercial HBM4 shipments and reported sustained transfer speed of 11.7 Gbit/s with capability up to 13 Gbit/s, alongside a 4 nm logic base die. These are vendor-reported product statements, not independent measurements.
evidence_candidates.statement_supported: Samsung reported in February 2026 that it had begun commercial HBM4 shipments with 11.7 Gbit/s transfer speed and capability up to 13 Gbit/s.
